subject: Request: SLA tier upgrade and premium support for renewal
messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@finservco.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: FinServCo Procurement <procure@finservco.com>
Date: Sat, 14 Feb 2026 09:03:00 -0800
Subject: Repeated outages this quarter — SLA concern ahead of renewal

Neha,

We're approaching our renewal with Redwood and we need to put the recent reliability issues on the table. Over the last six weeks we've seen three incidents that materially affected our API availability during business hours (Feb 02, Feb 07, Feb 10). The attached log summarizes error rates, incident windows, and estimated business impact.

High level:
- Feb 02: 18m partial outage, increased error rate for token generation (~12% failure for 30m)
- Feb 07: elevated p95 latency (350ms → 1.2s) during peak processing window (09:00 - 11:00 PST)
- Feb 10: 8m full routing failover while your fallback cluster warmed up

These incidents caused failed batch jobs on our end and delayed trade confirmations — not a small impact. We need clearer commitments on uptime and latency for the next contract term. Specifically we want:

1) A path to a contractual SLA tier with a 99.95% uptime commitment and p95 latency SLOs for our key routes;
2) Faster incident response and a named escalation contact;
3) Clear crediting for breaches (not just goodwill credits); and
4) A short trial of any "premium" tier to validate behavior before we finalize renewal terms.

Can you confirm whether Redwood can provide an amended SLA and what the timeline looks like to get a proposal (including cost deltas)? Procurement needs this information within 5 business days to avoid delaying our renewal sign-off.

I've attached the incident log (service_incident_log_Q1.csv).

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Head of Platform Reliability
FinServCo

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@finservco.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 14 Feb 2026 11:20:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Repeated outages this quarter — SLA concern ahead of renewal

Laura — thank you for the detailed summary and the incident log. I'm really sorry for the disruption to FinServCo's workloads and the downstream business impact. I appreciate how time-sensitive this is given your renewal window.

Immediate next steps from our side:
- I escalated this to our Reliability & Escalations team (cc'd: Evelyn) and to your account lead Marcus.
- We'll run a joint post-incident review (PIR) focused on root causes, mitigations deployed, and a prevention plan. I'll share a short PIR deck within 48 hours.
- Marcus will put together options for a contractual SLA amendment and a premium support tier we can put in front of Procurement.

For the request you outlined: we can propose a formal SLA amendment (targeting a 99.95% uptime option) and a premium support package with a named escalation channel and guaranteed response windows. There are a couple of implementation considerations (dedicated capacity vs. priority routing) that affect pricing — Marcus will include the trade-offs.

Can we schedule a 30-minute call Monday morning (Feb 16) to review the PIR findings and the SLA amendment draft? If Monday doesn't work, Marcus please propose two slots.

I know procurement's timeline is tight — we will prioritize this and give you a clear proposal before close of business on Thursday.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Senior Account Executive, Renewals
Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@finservco.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>, FinServCo Procurement <procure@finservco.com>
Date: Sun, 15 Feb 2026 09:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Proposed SLA amendment + premium support options (RDW-DEAL-7124)

Laura / team — following Neha's note, attached is a short proposal with two upgrade paths and estimated cost deltas. High level:

Option A — Premium SLA (recommended)
- 99.95% contractual uptime, monthly availability measurement, rollback credits for breach (tiered)
- p95 latency SLO for customer-named routes (example: inference.route.trade-confirm) at 60ms
- Dedicated priority routing and prefix KV caching for your peak routes
- 24/7 priority support with 1-hour initial response and a named escalation contact
- Price: +22% over current list (annualized)

Option B — Dedicated Capacity Pilot
- Reserved GPU pool with guaranteed throughput and isolated tenancy
- 99.97% uptime SLA for the dedicated pool; p95 latency target 50ms
- Required 3-month minimum commitment; higher capitalized cost

Attachments: proposed_sla_amendment_v2.pdf (amendment draft)

If helpful we can also provide a 2-week trial of the premium path (Option A) on a consumption-limited basis so you can validate latency and failover characteristics before signing. The trial would include a temporary escalation alias and weekly check-ins.

Proposed next steps:
1) PIR call Monday Feb 16, 10:00 - 10:30 PST (Neha, Laura, Marcus, Evelyn)
2) Post-call: Marcus to circulate final amendment + DocuSign link by Thursday EOD
3) If agreed, start 2-week trial within 48 hours of signature (trial details in appendix)

Laura — let me know if procurement needs adjusted commercial terms; we can model credit mechanics instead of pure percentage discounts.

Regards,
Marcus Lin
Account Executive
Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.com | +1 (650) 555-0199

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@finservco.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: FinServCo Procurement <procure@finservco.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Feb 2026 15:42:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Proposed SLA amendment + premium support options (RDW-DEAL-7124)

Thanks — appreciate the quick turnaround. The Monday slot works and we've added Procurement to the call. Two asks pre-call:

1) Please include the draft DocuSign (amendment) in the follow-up so Procurement can run legal review immediately.
2) We want to run the 2-week trial for Option A but with data collection hooks (trace IDs and synthetic checks) so our SREs can independently verify p95 latency during peak windows. Can you confirm Redwood will expose those trace samples for the trial?

If both are green we'll push to sign quickly.

Laura

On Sat, Feb 14, 2026 at 09:03 AM Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@finservco.com> wrote:
> Neha,
>
> We're approaching our renewal with Redwood and we need to put the recent reliability issues on the table...

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@finservco.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Feb 2026 16:22:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Proposed SLA amendment + premium support options (RDW-DEAL-7124)

Laura — following up on the PIR and Monday's call, confirming the actions we've committed to:

- Trial start: We will enable the 2-week premium trial for FinServCo starting Feb 19 09:00 PST. Trial will include: priority routing, prefix caching for your key routes, and the temporary escalation alias: finserv-escalation@redwood.com.
- Trace access: We will provide a limited trace export for the trial (redacted trace IDs and synthetic checks) via a shared Drive folder and a short lived API key. Details/links: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c
- DocuSign: Marcus will circulate the amendment in DocuSign by Thursday EOD for legal review.

Next steps for FinServCo:
1) Confirm trial start acceptance and provide two example route names you'd like measured.
2) Procurement to confirm whether they prefer credit mechanics or a flat percentage in the amendment (Marcus can re-price).

We'll also provision a named on-call contact (phone + PagerDuty) for the trial window.

Regards,
Evelyn Hart
Head, Reliability & Escalations
Redwood Inference
Evelyn_hart@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0177

Attachments referenced: proposed_sla_amendment_v2.pdf
